notes.title: Introduction & Development plans
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Thanks for taking the time to check this out. I just wanted to share some information about the game, current ongoing development, and future plans.

Above the Clouds has been under development for almost 2 years, the first Episode will be available on 1st of October for everyone to download and play, it includes over 3000 high quality renders, over 70 animations, over 5 hours of playtime, soundtracks and a lot of sound effects. The second and final episode will be released in Q1 2024.

Above the Clouds is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel, meaning that the choices you make will determine how it ends, there are multiple endings and some choices will have impact on a specific scene, or an interaction with a character, or it could unlock a wallpaper in the Gallery.
The game is fast-paced, lighthearted, full of humor and silliness. Of course, you'll get your lewd dose with the numerous sexy scenes, but you'll also fall in love with the story and characters! The game is full of mystery and have a unique style of storytelling, flashbacks, transitions and much more. It might feel chaotic for some, but everything will fall into place in time.

During the next few months, the game will be updated with different language translations, achievements, extra scenes and lewd content that won't affect the main story, but will enrich the overall player experience.

Here are some art that I made, that's unrelated to the game story, that show some of the characters of the game. 
I hope you enjoy!
